name: aiPHeed provincial food-stress risk forecast (E64 candidate, experimental)
status: EXPERIMENTAL - development evidence, not independently validated; enabled only with AIPHEED_LEAD2_MODEL=e64
modelVersion: E64-D: E56 LightGBM procedure family (structural CPI offset, intercept-free boosting, nested chronological selection) x I7 regional hunger component; news = pipeline v3 (protocol sha 2a37c236c9b7c44c)
quarterConvention: Lead-2: predictor quarter t = latest quarter with complete news; issue date = day 1 of quarter t+1; target = quarter t+2 (the quarter after the issue quarter).

dataFreshness.note: Target data (SWS hunger and PSA CPI) were known through 2026-Q2 at the issue date; predictors run through 2026-Q3 (CPI through 2026-08). The 2026-Q3 SWS round and September 2026 CPI were released after the issue date and are not used. Direct food-insecurity surveys (FNRI FIES, PSA subsistence) end in 2023.

information.rule: only data published before the origin

indicator.name: Food-Stress Risk Score (experimental)
indicator.definition: Model score for HIGH food-insecurity risk in the target quarter (target T43, Chapter I section 1.7): regional SWS hunger (Balance Luzon) above 11.3% AND provincial food-price pressure (PSA food inflation, or food minus headline inflation, above the province's 2021-2022 60th percentile). The regional hunger part and the provincial price part are estimated separately and multiplied; the two conditions are not independent, so the product is a model score, not a tested joint probability. A food-stress risk indicator, not a measured prevalence of household food insecurity.
indicator.horizon: two-quarter-ahead forecast issued 2026-10-01 from predictors through 2026-Q3
indicator.source: SWS hunger (Balance Luzon); PSA provincial food and headline CPI and wholesale rice; typhoon tracks and ENSO; PSA production; PSA LFS (national); BSP remittances and ECB USD/PHP (national); news pipeline v3 (classifier v2, FSSI-v3); official rice-policy orders
indicator.caveat: Food-stress risk indicator from regional hunger and provincial food prices, not a measured provincial prevalence. Development evidence only (E64). Indicative decision support only.

scoreTypes.food_insecurity_risk_probability: Model score for HIGH food-insecurity risk in the target quarter (target T43, Chapter I section 1.7): regional SWS hunger (Balance Luzon) above 11.3% AND provincial food-price pressure (PSA food inflation, or food minus headline inflation, above the province's 2021-2022 60th percentile). The regional hunger part and the provincial price part are estimated separately and multiplied; the two conditions are not independent, so the product is a model score, not a tested joint probability. A food-stress risk indicator, not a measured prevalence of household food insecurity.

attributionMethod: Exact TreeSHAP (LightGBM pred_contrib) of the food-price part, in log-odds, grouped by trigger; Market / Prices carries the projected food inflation built from PSA CPI; each group includes its own news signals (classifier v2); news coverage, outlets and FSSI-v3 are reported outside the five bars. Model attributions, not causes.

operationalRules.band: Low if P < 0.33; Watch if 0.33 <= P < 0.67; High if P >= 0.67
operationalRules.alert: Alert candidate when the band is High; staged for administrator confirmation.
operationalRules.municipal: No municipal probability; LGU rankings are relative prioritization weighted by PSA 2021 poverty and 2024 population density.
operationalRules.rollback: unset AIPHEED_LEAD2_MODEL (or set e38) to return to the production default E38

earlyWarningRule.rationale: E58 diagnosis: half of E56's missed HIGH rows came from a hunger reading 3-4 quarters older than the target suppressing a correct price signal; the warning is not suppressed by it.
limitations: Development evidence on 10 already-examined quarters; about 4 independent onset episodes.
In a low-hunger period EMERGING warnings may not become HIGH food-insecurity risk: in 2021-2023, 24 of 29 price-pressure province-quarters were not T43 HIGH.
A model warning for DA review; DA confirmation is separate.
